play.definition: A defensive play result in which the quarterback begins or remains in a passing posture, retains possession of the football, and is contacted and controlled by one or more defenders behind the line of scrimmage before completing a forward pass. The quarterback may be wrapped and brought to the ground, tripped, driven backward, forced out of bounds, or ruled down while under defensive control. The defining observable sequence is defensive access to the quarterback followed by contact, control, and termination of the play behind the line of scrimmage.

Action_None.label: None
Action_None.definition: A temporal label used when the player is visible but is not performing any defined football action in the action taxonomy during the annotated interval.

Action_PreSnap.label: Pre Snap
Action_PreSnap.definition: The period before the snap when players are set in formation and no active play has begun.

Action_ZoneBlock.label: Zone Block
Action_ZoneBlock.definition: An offensive lineman's block in a zone blocking scheme, where linemen are responsible for an area or 'zone' rather than a specific defender. They work in combination with adjacent linemen to create movement and open running lanes, often double-teaming and then releasing to the second level.
